bro.text: The Fallaji are the desert people of Terisiare, whose tribes are united by the younger Qadir into the Fallaji Empire and later ruled by Mishra, whose dragon engines make them the main body of his army in the Brothers' War.

After the Peace Summit at Korlinda fails over the Sword Marches and the Fallaji slaughter the Martyrs of Korlis, an Argivian and Korlisian army marches south, and Kroog falls to a Fallaji strike in a single morning.
Mishra's armies besiege Terisia City for months until the Brotherhood of Gix betrays it and opens the gates, and Fallaji forces push the Argivians back from Tomakul.
Yotia stays under Fallaji occupation for ten years before it is liberated by Argive and Korlis, and nearly all Fallaji die in the Last Battle, after which the empire collapses.
